**Text Classification and Core Themes**
The *Diamond Sutra*, also known by its Sanskrit title *Vajracchedikā Prajñāpāramitā Sūtra* (or *Vajracchedika Prajnaparamita Sutra*), is a Mahayana Buddhist scripture belonging to the "Perfection of Wisdom" genre [Source: ev-4].
Its primary teachings emphasize the practice of non-abiding and non-attachment [Source: ev-4].
It is considered one of the two most chanted sutras in Zen, alongside the Heart Sutra [Source: ev-3].
The text is described as cutting through Buddhist beliefs and showing that even important teachings are provisional [Source: ev-3].
